user.title: Well Monitor — Voltage Source
user.description: Select the sensor entity that reports the raw voltage from your depth sensor.

data_description.voltage_entity: The HA sensor entity that provides the raw analogue voltage from your depth/pressure transducer.

calibration.title: Well Monitor — Calibration
calibration.description:
Enter two known voltage/depth pairs to calibrate the linear depth scale.

Measure the actual water column height at two different well levels and record the corresponding sensor voltages.

data_description.cal_voltage_low: Sensor voltage when the water column depth equals the low reference value (often 0 V at empty).
data_description.cal_depth_low: Actual water column depth in metres at the low reference voltage (often 0.0 m).
data_description.cal_voltage_high: Sensor voltage at a known, higher water level.
data_description.cal_depth_high: Actual water column depth in metres at the high reference voltage.

geometry.title: Well Monitor — Well Geometry
geometry.description:
The well is assumed to be a cylinder. Volume is calculated from water depth × cross-sectional area.

Measure the internal diameter of the borehole casing, not the drill diameter.

data_description.well_diameter_mm: Internal diameter of the borehole casing in millimetres. Common sizes: 75 mm (3"), 100 mm (4"), 125 mm (5"), 150 mm (6").

error.voltage_high_must_exceed_low: High reference voltage must be greater than low reference voltage.
error.depth_high_must_exceed_low: High reference depth must be greater than low reference depth.
error.diameter_must_be_positive: Borehole diameter must be greater than zero.

init.title: Well Monitor — Reconfigure
init.description: Update calibration or geometry. The integration will reload immediately.

data_description.filter_method: Which filter turns the quantized sensor voltage into the level that feeds depth, volume and rates. 'Duty-cycle decoder' is the established default; 'Recharge model' is the experimental physical-model estimator.
